equipment_type: VRF indoor unit zone controller (room controller)
applies_to: LG MultiSITE CRC2+Z wall remote controller (PREMTBVC4) for LG VRF and single-zone indoor units, up to 16 indoor units per controller.
summary: The CRC2+Z is LG's touchscreen wall controller for LG indoor units. It talks LG V-Net (RS-485) to the indoor units and exposes about 360 BACnet objects on BACnet MS/TP, with optional BACnet wireless IP through a Wi-Fi module. The submittal splits the objects into commandable points (on/off, mode, fan speed, setpoints, setback and override settings, display options) and monitor points (room temperature, error codes, pipe temperatures, ZigBee sensor values).
notes: The submittal gives object name, type, ID and description only. Access is inferred from its two sections: objects in 'COMMANDABLE Points' are marked commandable (C) or writable (W for AI/CSV), objects in 'MONITOR Points' read-only.
No state texts or units are printed; read State_Text and Units from the controller.
BACnet IP is wireless and needs the optional VCM8002V504 Wi-Fi module.
ZB_Zone1-20 objects only report data for paired ZigBee Pro sensors (up to 20).
Some printed descriptions repeat odd text (MV 790 'Ovverride', MI 188 Zone8 description on the Zone9 object); names are kept as printed.
Available functions differ with the connected indoor unit; some points apply only to dual vane 4-way cassettes or ventilation AHUs.

source.title: MultiSITE CRC2+Z Remote Controller submittal (PREMTBVC4), BACnet commandable and monitor points

integration.summary: Turn the indoor unit(s) on/off with MV 528 IDUonOff, set the mode with MV 16 and fan speed with MV 17, and write the setpoints (AV 39/AV 40 for dual setpoint, or AV 507 for single setpoint as chosen by MV 538). Read AV 100 room temperature, MI 602 occupancy status, AI 503 current error code and BV 500 filter alarm.

minimum_points.name: SingleSP
minimum_points.why: Setpoint when single setpoint mode is used

setup: BACnet MS/TP is built in; BACnet wireless IP needs the optional VCM8002V504 Wi-Fi module.
AV 10 BACnetComAddr is the BACnet communications address; AV 16 is the BACnet stack poll rate.
The controller connects to the indoor units over LG V-Net (3-conductor 22 AWG, up to 164 ft) and can group up to 16 indoor units.
gotchas: MV 538 SingleDualSP decides whether AV 507 or AV 39/AV 40 is in use.
Central controller limits (AI 510-515) can restrict the setpoint range.
BV 557 TestModeOccupancy is marked 'Reserved/Do Not Use'.
AV 56 ConfigPassword and AV 57 UserPassword hold the controller passwords.
